review:
Tramp Day is a quirky Bonanza-style 6x5 slot about a cheerful tramp searching for treasures among discarded items: doughnuts, cans, pizza and, with luck, cash. Symbols pay anywhere and refill after each win.

Random multiplier symbols can appear in both the base game and free spins, which gives ordinary spins more upside than the original Bonanza Billion. Chance x2 and a bonus buy are available where permitted. BGaming rates it very high volatility with a 5,000x maximum, and the 97.17% RTP is excellent. Free spins arrive about once every 163 spins, more frequently than most Bonanza titles.
pros: Excellent 97.17% RTP – among the highest published
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
